title: UnivNews — University Digital Journalism Portal & CMS
description: Platform portal berita digital multi-kampus modern berbasis Laravel dengan isolasi autentikasi peran (Public Readers, Authors, Admins), manajemen editorial, dan antarmuka responsif.
abstract: UnivNews Architecture — Multi-role RBAC authentication, digital editorial CMS pipelines, responsive journalism layout, dan isolated university news catalog.

caseStudy.process: Built a Laravel-based multi-campus digital news portal with multi-role RBAC authentication isolation (Public Readers, Authors, Admins), digital editorial CMS pipelines, and an isolated university news catalog. Implemented concurrent multi-campus feed aggregation normalizing RSS and REST sources, stale-while-revalidate client caching, in-memory fuzzy search indexing, and a responsive journalism layout.

title: App_PADi — Platform Absensi Digital (Mobile & Backend)
description: Sistem absensi digital terintegrasi memadukan aplikasi mobile Flutter dengan backend Node.js, Express, dan Prisma ORM, dilengkapi validasi radius geofencing dan rekap kehadiran real-time.
abstract: App_PADi Architecture — Geofence radius attendance validation, Prisma ORM PostgreSQL transactions, dan cross-platform Flutter mobile UI.

caseStudy.process: Built an integrated digital attendance system pairing a cross-platform Flutter mobile UI (with optimistic UI updates and local persistence) with a Node.js and Express backend. Implemented mathematical GPS geofence radius boundary validation to prevent mock locations, real-time attendance recaps, and Prisma ORM ACID transactions backed by PostgreSQL relational constraints.

title: Sistem Informasi LSP POLINES — Sertifikasi Kompetensi
description: Sistem informasi manajemen sertifikasi kompetensi profesi untuk Lembaga Sertifikasi Profesi (LSP) Politeknik Negeri Semarang, mendigitalisasi alur pendaftaran asesi hingga penerbitan sertifikat.
abstract: LSP Polines Architecture — End-to-end competency certification workflow, assessor evaluation ledger, dan automated certificate verification.

caseStudy.process: Digitized the professional competency certification management workflow for Lembaga Sertifikasi Profesi (LSP) Politeknik Negeri Semarang, covering assessee registration through automated certificate verification and issuance. Structured around an end-to-end competency certification workflow, assessor evaluation ledger, real-time competency rubric evaluation matrices, modular REST API and document modeling, and multi-tier role-based access control (RBAC) separating student submissions, assessor evaluations, and institution audits.

title: Micro-Local Climate Monitor & Predictor (IoT & ML)
description: Stasiun cuaca mikro-lokal hiperlokal berbasis Dual ESP32 LoRa-WiFi terintegrasi Machine Learning (TensorFlow) untuk pemantauan atmosfer lingkungan dan peramalan hujan presisi tinggi.
abstract: Micro-Local Climate Architecture — Dual ESP32 915MHz LoRa telemetry telemetry array, time-series TensorFlow neural inference, dan cloud PostgreSQL sink.

caseStudy.process: Developed a hyperlocal micro-climate weather station using a Dual ESP32 915MHz LoRa-WiFi telemetry array and Arduino sensor arrays with automated drift compensation for continuous atmospheric monitoring. Built an event-driven Python Flask ingestion tier streaming verified sensor packets into a cloud PostgreSQL sink, paired with TensorFlow time-series recurrent regression models for localized barometric, atmospheric, and rain forecasting.

title: Dashboard Web Map Contour — Geospatial Elevation GIS
description: Platform visualisasi geospasial interaktif pemetaan garis kontur medan topografi dan elevasi ketinggian lereng, mendukung layer GeoJSON/Shapefile dinamis dan analisis spasial web.
abstract: Web Map Contour Architecture — Topographic contour isoclines calculation, D3.js vector GIS rendering, dan hypsometric elevation color mapping.

caseStudy.process: Built an interactive geospatial visualization platform for mapping topographic terrain contour lines and slope elevation, supporting dynamic GeoJSON/Shapefile layers and web spatial analysis. Implemented vector contour isocline computation with D3.js and hardware-accelerated canvas mapping, an asynchronous spatial geometry parsing pipeline for multi-polygon boundary overlays, and hypsometric elevation color interpolation.
